title: Devil's Den Official Modpack
description: A modpack dedicated to the Devil's Den discord server
body:
A modpack for the [Devil's Den Official Discord Server](https://discord.gg/6MdSxCVXCe)
This modpack is a nice mix of building, exploration, technology, and magic, made to appeal to anyone and everyone.
If you like Create, Alex's Caves, Yung's Structures, Iron Spells, Simply Swords, Dragon Remaster, and so much more, you'll love this modpack.

Important: This modpack plays best with larger amounts of ram, 8 GB runs best, and it may run with 6 GB if you have a weaker computer.
